snapshot_witness_attestation.description: One witness statement that the snapshot issuer held snapshot-sealing authority for this exact reduced state at manifest created_at. It is a distinct object family from the manifest itself: the witness signs the canonical SnapshotWitnessAttestation projection of snapshot-schema.md section 5.1 under context ak.snapshot_witness_attestation_proof.v1, which binds the snapshot identity, state, frontier, event-set commitment and authority state but excludes every signature and proof field, so a witness never signs a transcript containing its own or another witness's signature. The manifest-level ak.snapshot_proof.v1 context MUST NOT be reused here.

witness_id.description: Stable did_core_id of the witness. The proof verification_method stays a full DID URL whose bare controller full_id is validated and projected to this value by the registered method adapter; direct full-DID/core-id string comparison is forbidden. Quorum counting is per witness_id, so several keys of one witness count once.

proof.description: Detached proof whose payload_digest is the SHA-256 typed digest of the JCS canonical SnapshotWitnessAttestation projection (snapshot-schema.md section 5.1). Verifiers MUST recompute the projection from the manifest and this row's witness_id and MUST reject any other transcript.

security_class.description: Snapshot verification class. high_assurance requires verification_hints with inclusion challenge and non-accepted-input digests.

state_digest.description: RFC 6962 domain-separated Merkle root of the canonical reducer-derived state at the snapshot frontier (Lattice cell values keyed by cell_family/cell_subject, plus reducer_profile / schema_profile_refs): leaf=H(0x00||leaf_data), node=H(0x01||left||right), odd tail promoted. This binds *what the state is*. Paired with event_set_commitment which binds *which events produced it*: a verifier replays the events covered by event_set_commitment under reducer_profile and MUST obtain the same state_digest. The two digests are independent and BOTH required — state_digest alone cannot detect missing-event tampering, event_set_commitment alone cannot detect reducer divergence.

frontier.$comment: This is a true frontier (boundary head event ids of the snapshot), not a cumulative covered-set enumeration. Seal coverage is recursive via predecessor_refs + delta.

event_set_commitment.description: Commitment to the set of events whose replay produces state_digest. merkle_event_set_v1 uses the same RFC 6962 domain-separated family as state_digest and Seal roots: leaf=H(0x00||leaf_data), node=H(0x01||left||right), odd tail promoted. Algorithm + root + covered_event_count name the canonical reduction; actor_seq_ranges may further bind per-actor sequences. Boundary Event IDs are carried once by top-level frontier.event_ids.

created_by.description: Stable did_core_id of the snapshot issuer (server / Realm notary / federation witness). The signature transcript binds this business identity; its full DID URL verification_method is independently validated and projected to this value by the registered method adapter.

created_at.description: Issuer-local timestamp when the snapshot manifest was sealed. RFC 3339 UTC, MUST end with 'Z'. Required because the snapshot signature transcript binds this field via x-canonical-bytes-include.

authority_binding.description: Evidence that created_by was authorized to seal this snapshot at created_at. Verifiers MUST reject the snapshot when this binding cannot be checked against Realm policy / witness quorum at or before created_at. authority_kind=witness_quorum additionally requires the typed witness_attestations list below; there is no untyped alternative carrier.

auth_state_digest.description: Hash of the authorization state used to verify snapshot issuer authority.

auth_frontier.description: Realm auth/policy frontier proving the signer authority at created_at.

witness_attestations.description: Typed witness quorum evidence. Rows MUST be sorted by witness_id in UTF-8 byte order and witness_id MUST be unique across rows. Each witness signs the signature-free SnapshotWitnessAttestation projection first; the issuer then signs the manifest containing this final ordered list. Quorum admission uses only the accepted Realm auth/policy state resolved from auth_frontier / auth_state_digest at manifest created_at.

signature.description: Detached proof over the JCS canonical snapshot manifest bytes with only the signature field omitted. The signed transcript therefore binds id, realm_id, reducer_profile, schema_profile_refs, state_digest, frontier, event_set_commitment, chunks (chunk_ref / digest / size_bytes), security_class, verification_hints, created_by, created_at, and authority_binding — including the final sorted authority_binding.witness_attestations list, so a rewritten, truncated or reordered witness set invalidates this signature. Because security_class is signed (and required), a high_assurance -> standard downgrade cannot be performed without invalidating the signature. This transcript uses context ak.snapshot_proof.v1; each witness attestation uses the separate ak.snapshot_witness_attestation_proof.v1 context and never signs this transcript, which is what keeps the two levels acyclic.
